title: Pricing
summary: Openslot pricing: a free plan with no card, Pro from $12 per user per month, Team from $25, and Enterprise with SSO and audit logs.
heading: Pay for the people who host meetings
text: Start free and stay free if one booking page is all you need. Every paid plan has a 14-day Team trial with no card.

plans.name: Free
plans.text: One booking page, for one person who just needs a link.

plans.name: Pro
plans.text: For one person or a small team who books all day.

plans.name: Team
plans.text: For teams where a booking has to reach the right person.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.text: For organizations with procurement and a security review.

note: Prices are per user, per month, and exclude tax. The Team trial runs for 14 days and does not ask for a card.

closing.heading: Try Team for 14 days
closing.text: No card, no sales call, and nothing locks when the trial ends. The workspace drops to Free and your links keep working.
closing.note: Cancel any time, from inside the app.
